title: Role tracks, FDE practice and breadth electives
summary: Choose your track (AI Engineer, FDE, MLOps) from real job evidence, then practise the FDE engagement loop end to end with a real user: discovery, scoping and metrics, enterprise integration, offline/on-prem deployment, co-built evals with a feedback ratchet, and communication. FDE practice is core for the FDE track, strongly recommended for AI Engineers, optional for MLOps. Pick one breadth elective (deep). Primary spine for FDE: rohitg00 phase 14 lessons 43–54.

capstone.title: FDE engagement case study
capstone.brief: Run the full FDE arc with one real user over 4–6 weeks: discovery → signed scope → integration with a real system → offline-capable deployment → co-built eval set → readout and handover. Required for the FDE track, recommended for AI Engineers.

levels: 3: evidence-labelled workflow map; the real problem refines the initial ask
3: signed scope with baseline metric, out-of-scope items, cost estimate
3: real integration running in a constrained environment with a runbook
3: user-labelled eval, before/after numbers, adoption/usage data, honest limits
3: ADRs, weekly updates, 5-minute demo, handover doc a stranger could operate
